documents.title: Shareholder Meeting / Postal Ballot-Outcome of AGM
NOTICE FOR PAYMENT OF FIRST AND FINAL CALL TO THE HOLDERS OF PARTLY PAID-UP EQUITY SHARES

analysis.summary: California Software Company Limited issued its Annual Report for the financial year 2025-26 along with the notice for its 34th Annual General Meeting scheduled for September 29, 2026. The document details administrative instructions for conducting the meeting via video conferencing, remote e-voting procedures, and statutory disclosures regarding the retirement by rotation and re-appointment of directors and independent directors. Management stated that no dividend was declared for the year 2015-16, rendering unclaimed dividend transfers to IEPF inapplicable. The report also provides background profiles and justifications for the re-appointment of key managerial personnel and board members. In its 2025 Annual Report, California Software Company Limited highlighted its strategic focus on empowering small and microbusinesses through accessible, AI-driven solutions in FY 2024-25.

demand_outlook.claim: Management stated that there is enormous latent demand in the small business segment for technology that is both powerful and practical.
demand_outlook.quote: This growth validated our thesis that there is enormous latent demand in the small business segment for technology that is both powerful and practical.

orders_capacity.claim: The company's dSpeedUp digital ecosystem grew to serve over 1000 merchants during the year.
orders_capacity.quote: dSpeedUp’s digital ecosystem grew to serve over 1000 merchants, achieving 95% annual client retention as small retailers and service providers embraced the platform’s benefits..

capital_allocation.claim: The company stated that as no dividend was declared for the year 2015-16, the transfer of unclaimed dividend and associated shares to the IEPF account does not arise.
capital_allocation.quote: As the Company has not declared any dividend for the year 2015-16, the transfer of the amount of dividend that remains unclaimed for a period of 7 years to the IEPF account and the shares on which dividends remain unpaid or unclaimed for a period of seven consecutive years or more to the Demat account of IEPF Authority does not arise;

management_commitments.claim: The company invested heavily in AI-powered platforms tailored to small business needs during the fiscal year.
management_commitments.quote: The Company invested heavily in AI-powered platforms tailored to small business needs, introduced affordable pricing models, and provided training and support to lower barriers to adoption.

_meta.note: Facts are verbatim-grounded against the company's own documents; claims whose quote was not found were dropped.
